title: HMS Kurdistan allowed signers of sign-off records
description: docs/safety/signoffs/allowed-signers.yaml: the keys whose holders may sign sign-off records, with the roles each person signs in (BUILD-PROMPT.md §3.5; docs/safety/signoffs/README.md). Only a human adds or changes an entry; the build agent never does. `sh tools/hms safety check` validates the working-tree file against this schema and each committed version against the schema committed with it, accepts a record only from commits with a good signature by a listed key, and trusts the committed list only as far as its git history allows (KA-011).

signers.description: One entry per key. A person with two keys has two entries with the same name and roles. An empty list means no record can authorise anything.

role.description: A role id as approval.required uses it (Appendix B.3), for example cso, pharmacist-panel, nurse-panel.

name.description: The person's full name, exactly as they write it in the name field of their records.

roles.description: The roles the person may sign records in. A record's role must be one of them.

key_type.description: gpg (an OpenPGP key) or ssh (an SSH signing key).

fingerprint.description: The full fingerprint of the key. gpg: 40 (v4) or 64 (v5) upper-case hex digits without spaces, as git's %GF and %GP and `gpg --with-colons --fingerprint` print them; a signature by a subkey matches its primary key's fingerprint. ssh: SHA256: and 43 base64 characters, as `ssh-keygen -lf` and git's %GF print them.

added.description: The date the entry was added (YYYY-MM-DD).
